content:
jordan: kickstarting the synapse regional rollout. plan: US -> EU -> APAC, staged canaries with explicit model pin and fallback. posting preflight numbers now.

deploy-bot: queued: `deployctl run --service synapse --regions us,eu,apac --canary 0.5% --stagger regionwise`

maria: quick capacity snapshot: warm GPUs (after warmup): US 50, EU 38, APAC 24. target 10% spare headroom. collecting token qps baselines.

kevin: prefer pinning to v2.3.1 for canary, fallback v2.3.0. v2.4 had minor mem pressure.

nina: I can add manifest pin: `model.version: v2.3.1` in rollout config; will do if no objections.

jordan: do it as arg for now: `--model-version v2.3.1 --fallback v2.3.0`. if instability -> immediate rollback to fallback.

sre-ops: post-sweep: US available GPUs 53, EU 40, APAC 26. estimated headroom at p95: US 1.9x, EU 1.4x, APAC 1.05x. APAC is borderline.

maria: APAC needs a short burst reservation of 6 GPUs from dedicated pool for initial cutover. filing infra request.

kevin: approve burst. If APAC headroom <1.2x within 3 minutes of canary start, we pause APAC and redistribute per routing policy.

deploy-bot: US canary started (1%) job 4ac2. health hooks: perf, errors, kv-cache.

nina: US smoke @30s: p95 230ms (SLO 300), errors 0.1%. all good.

maria: infra granted 6 GPUs to APAC (TICKET-7841). billing ok.

kevin: expanding US canary to 5% after green. EU scheduled to start in 10m.

jordan: note: watch kv-cache eviction metric and aio-error counters. set temporary alert: `kv_cache_evictions > 50/min` -> page SRE.

sre-ops: alert created.

nina: EU canary started, initial p95 295ms, errors 0.4% within budget.

maria: APAC preflight still shows higher cold-starts. recommend delaying APAC by 5 minutes to allow warm pool ramp.

kevin: fine to delay. jordan, update deploy job to `--region-delay apac=300s`.

jordan: done, holding APAC cutover 5m. will update release notes with delay rationale.

deploy-bot: EU canary healthy -> expanded to 12%. US/EU combined p95 ~255ms.

maria: APAC warmup meters now at expected; proceeding to canary.

deploy-bot: APAC canary start (1%) job 4ac2-2.

nina: APAC first minute: p95 360ms (SLO 400), errors 0.5%. kv-cache evictions steady.

sre-ops: cost delta observed: token processing cost +1.8% on v2.3.1 due to batching change. Ops okay.

maria: rolling expansion to 30% global. product: release notes updated with known perf vs cost note.

kevin: leaving channel; set auto-escalate if rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: rollout at 60% global. autoscale steady.

jordan: post-roll: run eval-suite A (eval-2026-03-21-synapse). if regressions >0.8% -> quality rollback.

nina: eval-suite started, will report in 20m.

deploy-bot: rollout complete, pinned v2.3.1, fallback v2.3.0.

maria: noting in runbook: APAC required a short delay and temporary burst GPUs to avoid cold starts. will update the runbook.

jordan: excellent, closing thread unless rollback needed. :tada:
